sections.title: What is Reading Comprehension?
points: Understanding the meaning of what you read
Finding the main idea and supporting details
Understanding the author's message or lesson

sections.title: Key Reading Skills
points: Main Idea: What is the passage mostly about?
Details: What specific information supports the main idea?
Inference: What can we conclude from the information?
Purpose: Why did the author write this?
Theme: What is the life lesson or message?

sections.title: How to Read Better
points: Read slowly and carefully — don't rush!
Ask questions as you read: Who? What? When? Where? Why?
Summarize: Retell the story in your own words
Look for keywords and important names
Think about what happened and why it matters

sections.text: Tip: Reading comprehension is like detective work! Look for clues in the text to answer your questions.
